character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Full-body pixel art character sprite of a massive, heavily built barbarian dwarf warrior, pixel perfect, isolated on a solid white background.

Physical Features: Extremely muscular and stocky physique with a large, heavy torso, strong thick legs, and massive forearms. Bare-chested with visible chest hair, body scars across the chest and legs, and dark black Nordic/Viking tribal tattoos on his right arm and shoulder (including a Vegvisir compass symbol on the shoulder).

Head & Hair: Long brown wavy hair tied in a half-up ponytail style. Thick, braided long brown beard split into twin braids with metallic ring fasteners. Stern, fierce expression with thick eyebrows and rugged facial features.

Clothing: Wearing only bright red loincloth/undergarments and brown leather gladiator-style sandals with double metal buckles around the ankles.

Weapons & Pose: Standing in a solid full-body front-facing stance, holding a massive, battle-worn double-headed battle axe vertically in his left hand resting near the ground. The axe head has ancient runic engravings carved into the steel blade. Right hand is clenched into a fist at his side.

Style: 16-bit high-detail retro pixel art, crisp outlines, clean sprite sheet aesthetic.
